title: Faithful Imprints 32x
description: Faithful 32x imprint textures for the Soft Imprints mod
body:
![Husk&Camel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef1afbedea91beb11a6285039be214d18b97f334.webp) ## About A resource pack for the **Soft Imprints** mod that provides imprint textures in the Faithful 32x style.
There are **Sand**, **Red Sand**, and **Snow** imprints here. ## Requirements - [Soft Imprints](https://modrinth.com/mod/snow-imprints) - [Faithful 32x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/faithful-32x) (optional) ## Credits - Faithful: https://faithfulpack.net/ - Imprint Textures are licensed under the [Faithful License](https://faithfulpack.net/license) ## More screenshots
In-game view and Config Screen ![Settings x32](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/020e2394c97502c482aebffb821301bdf0a75473.webp) ![Sheep](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5299e0cb18759f0e03004790453e53186239d061.webp)
